title: Record or property?
instruction: In a data export from a network: what is one record (a row), and what is a property (a column)?

items.text: One view of a video at 21:14

items.why: An item that every view has.

items.text: One like under a particular photo

items.why: A column you can sort by.

debrief: A row is one thing that happened. A column is an item that every row has. That is what makes sorting, filtering and calculating possible.
